args.subject: Bulk hoodie availability and proposed discount
args.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

We currently have 8 of the 20 requested size M hoodies in stock, leaving 12 unavailable. Restocking is currently blocked while a vendor invoice remains unpaid; after it is cleared, restocking would take 5 days. We’ll confirm a date once restocking is approved and the vendor can ship.

For the eventual 20-hoodie order, we can propose a 10% bulk discount, bringing the price to $52.20 each instead of $58. This is proposed, pending manager approval, and contingent on inventory/restocking being available. At that price, it is $30.20 above the $22 unit cost.

Campus Customs

after.subject: Your bulk hoodie request: 8 available now at 10% off
after.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

Thank you for your bulk order request. We can offer the 8 size M Basic Hoodie Big Yale hoodies we currently have in stock at a 10% bulk discount: $52.20 each instead of $58.00, or $417.60 for all 8.

We can't promise the remaining 12 size M hoodies yet. We'll contact you as soon as we can confirm when more will be available. If other sizes work for some of your members, we also have S, L and XL in stock.

Please let us know if you'd like to go ahead with the 8 hoodies.

Campus Customs
